name: Ember crucible
description: Forge moons ring a dying red giant; everything smells of hot metal.

name: Gilded span
description: Palace stations and toll bridges along the richest lane in the arm.

name: Neon reach
description: Chrome arcologies and black-market data havens under a magenta sky.

name: Pale expanse
description: Glacier mines and silent relay stations at the cold edge of the arm.

name: Pelagic deep
description: Drowned colonies and kelp farms beneath storm-wracked ocean worlds.

name: Phosphor wastes
description: Abandoned machine yards where every screen still burns the same green.

name: Rust belt
description: Scrap haulers and furnace towns along a dying industrial arm.

name: Umbral drift
description: Smuggler fleets navigate a lightless nebula by whisper and wake.

name: Verdant arm
description: Terraced farm moons and slow river freighters on the green frontier.
